scaleNote.zh-Hans: 字号和行高是我们自己的提案：行高都是 4px 的整数倍，大字号的字距略收紧。没有对照任何参考应用测量，也没有在原生界面里验证。
scaleNote.en-US: Sizes and line heights are our own proposal: every line height is a multiple of 4px and large sizes tighten tracking slightly. Not measured against any reference app and not verified in a native UI.

why.zh-Hans: 界面主字体的首选。为屏幕上的小字号阅读而设计，字重和字形齐全，是目前最常见的界面字体之一，换成别的字体时也最容易找到对应的回退。局限：不含中文，需要配合中文字体。
why.en-US: First choice for UI text. It is designed for reading small text on screens, has a wide range of weights, and is one of the most widely used interface fonts, so it is easy to fall back from. Limit: no Chinese glyphs, so pair it with a CJK font.

note.zh-Hans: OFL 允许随应用打包和再分发：要附上许可证全文和版权声明，不能把字体单独出售。名字里带“保留字体名”的字体，改造后的版本不能继续用原名。
note.en-US: The OFL allows bundling and redistribution with an app: keep the license text and copyright notice, and do not sell the font by itself. Where a Reserved Font Name applies, modified versions must not reuse that name.

why.zh-Hans: 界面字体的备选。几何感更强，更像“工具”而不是“读物”，和 Next.js 站点搭配自然。局限：不含中文；字形比 Inter 更有个性，长段正文读起来略紧。
why.en-US: An alternative for UI text. More geometric, it feels like a tool rather than reading matter, and it sits naturally in Next.js sites. Limits: no Chinese glyphs, and its stronger personality reads slightly tight in long body text.

note.zh-Hans: OFL 允许随应用打包和再分发：要附上许可证全文和版权声明，不能把字体单独出售。名字里带“保留字体名”的字体，改造后的版本不能继续用原名。

why.zh-Hans: 简体中文界面字体的首选（即思源黑体）。字重多、覆盖广，和 Inter 搭配时粗细比较协调。局限：文件体积大，网页上需要子集化或按需加载。
why.en-US: First choice for Simplified Chinese UI text (the same design as Source Han Sans). Many weights, wide coverage, and its stroke weight pairs well with Inter. Limit: large files, so subset or load on demand on the web.
